transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. As you know, we have the battery-storage installation proposal on this month's capital-planning agenda. The current proposal is a $6,000,000 purchase where we'd own the equipment outright. Before I make an approval decision, I'd like to hear from each of you — FP&A, tax, treasury, and legal — on anything relevant you'd like to flag regarding this project. Let's go around the table.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I completed the project cash-flow model this morning. At our required return hurdle, the economically approvable purchase price is $4,800,000 — the $6,000,000 proposal does not pass the model's hurdle. I have not yet attached the completed model to the investment-review file, but I'm flagging this now so Maya has it before making a decision.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to flag something important on the tax side. I received a tax memorandum this week confirming that the 30% investment credit available for this battery-storage project is only available if the company owns the equipment outright. If we were to structure this as a lease instead of a purchase, that credit would be unavailable. Since the current proposal has us purchasing and owning the equipment, we would qualify for the credit. I have not yet circulated the memorandum to the planning team, but I'm sharing this now so it's on the record before Maya makes her decision.

transcript.text: On the treasury side, I need to flag a funding constraint. In today's rolling cash forecast, I confirmed that only $2,000,000 can be deployed without breaching our operating-liquidity floor. The remaining $2,800,000 can be funded through an available five-year term-loan facility. I have not yet updated the funding worksheet, but I'm sharing this now so it's on the record before Maya makes her decision.

Energization of the battery-storage system requires a $400,000 performance bond and a signed commissioning certificate before the system can be placed in service. I have not yet added these conditions to the draft approval, but I'm sharing this now so it's on the record before Maya makes her decision.
